steps.label: Loading Roster
steps.note: Runs in-process (Node/dashboard). No browser. Emits pending row, optionally dispatches SharePoint roster download, loads roster from disk, pre-renders PDF pages into pdf-cache, seeds placeholder records into the Preview tab.

operations.label: Emit pending tracker row
operations.summary: Writes the initial pending OCR row to JSONL with formType, pdfPath, pdfOriginalName, sessionId, rosterMode.

operations.label: Emit running step=loading-roster
operations.summary: Writes running row with step=loading-roster so session drawer advances.

operations.label: Dispatch SharePoint roster download (rosterMode=download|wait)
operations.summary: When rosterMode='download' or 'wait', calls requestSharePointDownload and awaits the download result. Parented under the OCR runId. Skipped when rosterMode='existing'.
operations.note: Optional — only when rosterMode is 'download' or 'wait'.

operations.label: Load and precompute roster from disk
operations.summary: Reads the XLSX/CSV roster file from resolvedRosterPath, precomputes match structures. Skipped (empty roster) when rosterMode='optional' and no path resolved.

operations.label: Pre-render PDF pages into pdf-cache
operations.summary: Calls ensurePdfPageCache to rasterize all PDF pages to PNG so the Preview tab populates page images immediately. Wrapped in raceOcrPrepWithDiscard.

operations.label: Emit placeholder snapshot with blank records
operations.summary: Emits running step=ocr snapshot with one form-spec-shaped placeholder record per rendered page (spec.placeholderFields). Dashboard Preview tab shows blank inputs immediately.

steps.label: OCR (read + match + disambiguate)
steps.note: Runs LLM OCR pipeline against pre-rendered page images, matches extracted records against the roster, re-reads suspect pages on a tier-1 model, applies carry-forward from a prior reupload, disambiguates ambiguous roster candidates, computes lookup suggestions. All within-process — no browser.

operations.label: Run LLM OCR pipeline
operations.summary: Calls runOcrPipeline with the PDF path, pageImagesDir, spec.ocrRecordSchema, spec.prompt. Uses the multi-provider vision pool. Returns per-page success/failure status and extracted records.

operations.label: Compute failedPages, emptyPages, pageStatusSummary
operations.summary: Derives failedPages (OCR failed on page), emptyPages (OCR succeeded but produced zero records), and summary counts from ocrResult.pages.

operations.label: Emit snapshot with OCR-extracted records (pre-match)
operations.summary: Emits running step=ocr snapshot carrying raw extracted records so Preview tab shows extracted names/dates before matching runs.

operations.label: Match each record against roster (spec.matchRecord)
operations.summary: Calls spec.matchRecord({ record, roster }) for each extracted record in parallel. Sets matchState, matchSource, matchConfidence, rosterCandidates.

operations.label: Second-opinion re-read for suspect pages
operations.summary: For records that matched nothing in the roster AND have no usable EID, re-reads the page on a tier-1 accuracy model (runOcrSecondOpinionPage), re-matches, and adopts the new reading only when it ranks strictly better. Capped by OCR_SECOND_OPINION_MAX (default 5). Skipped when roster is empty.
operations.note: Optional — only when at least one suspect record exists and roster is loaded.

operations.label: Emit snapshot post-matching
operations.summary: Emits running step=ocr snapshot with post-match records (badges + EIDs where roster auto-accepted).

operations.label: Carry-forward resolved fields from previous run (reupload)
operations.summary: When input.previousRunId is set, reads the prior OCR row's records and calls applyCarryForward to merge already-resolved fields (EID, matchState) onto v2 re-extracted records via Levenshtein key match.

operations.label: Disambiguate ambiguous roster candidates via LLM
operations.summary: For records left lookup-pending with rosterCandidates (and not form-eid or manual), calls disambiguateMatch concurrently (up to OCR_DISAMBIG_CONCURRENCY=4). Applies spec.applyDisambiguation with the chosen EID/confidence.
operations.note: Optional — only when at least one ambiguous record exists.

operations.label: Compute LLM lookup suggestions for unmatched records
operations.summary: For records still lookup-pending with needsLookup='name' and no rosterCandidates, calls suggestLookupCandidates (LLM). Suggestions may include an EID hint that becomes a verify-only lookup target.
operations.note: Optional — only when unmatched-by-roster name-lookup records exist.

operations.label: Emit snapshot before person-lookup fan-out
operations.summary: Emits running step=person-lookup snapshot if there are lookup targets, so Preview keeps showing current records while fan-out runs.

steps.label: Person Lookup (EID resolution + enrichment)
steps.note: Fans out delegated person-lookup child runs (one per unresolved record), optionally via SQLite task dependencies. Watches outcomes and patches records progressively. An optional spec.enrichRecords hook (verify form only) fans out to person-lookup + i9-lookup for bespoke enrichment.

operations.label: Build lookup targets list
operations.summary: Filters records to those needing a lookup (needsLookup='name'|'verify'|'verify-only'). Generates itemIds (ocrChildItemIdPrefix-runId-rN). Applies LLM suggestion EIDs as verify-only lookup targets when present.

operations.label: Fan-out to person-lookup via delegateToAllImpl
operations.summary: Calls delegateToAllImpl({ child: personLookupWorkflow, inputs, fireAndForget:true, deriveItemId, rootTracePrefix, daemonFlags }). Each child is a delegated single row under the OCR runId.

operations.label: Create SQLite task dependency batch
operations.summary: Calls createOcrEidLookupDependencyBatch to record OCR → person-lookup dependencies in SQLite. On setup failure falls back to direct watchChildRuns.

operations.label: Wake dependency scheduler tick
operations.summary: Calls runDependencySchedulerTickForTrackerDir so the scheduler picks up the new person-lookup tasks immediately rather than waiting for its next poll interval.

operations.label: Watch person-lookup child outcomes (watchChildRuns)
operations.summary: Blocks until all expected person-lookup child itemIds complete or timeout (default 1h). On each outcome (onProgress) patches the record via patchOcrRecordFromEidLookupOutcome and debounce-emits a progress snapshot.

operations.label: spec.enrichRecords hook (verify form only)
operations.summary: Awaits spec.enrichRecords for bespoke enrichment. verify form fans out to person-lookup (CRM employment/oath dates, active status) and i9-lookup (authorized-official signer) via delegateToAllImpl + watchChildRuns, then patches records with applyPersonLookupToVerifyRecord / applyI9ToVerifyRecord.
operations.note: Optional — only when spec.enrichRecords is declared (verify form only for current specs).

operations.label: Emit snapshot after lookups complete
operations.summary: Emits running step=person-lookup snapshot with fully-patched records.

steps.label: Awaiting Approval / Terminal
steps.note: SPLITS on delegation: standalone runs (no parentRunId) emit terminal done at step=person-lookup and return {status:'complete'}. Delegated runs (parentRunId set) park at running step=awaiting-approval, then the kernel handler subscribes to the approval signal. On approve, records/fannedOutItemIds are stamped onto ctx; on discard, OcrDiscardedError is thrown → kernel emits failed.

operations.label: Standalone: emit terminal done snapshot
operations.summary: When completesAfterLookup=true (no parentRunId), emitSnapshot(records, 'person-lookup', 'done') and return {status:'complete'}. Handler seeds ctx.updateData({...reviewData, mode:'prepare'}) for the kernel's terminal row.

operations.label: Delegated: emit running step=awaiting-approval snapshot
operations.summary: Emits running step=awaiting-approval snapshot carrying all records + failedPages/emptyPages. Dashboard OcrReviewPane shows Approve/Discard controls.

operations.label: Delegated: wait on approval signal (subscribeToApproval)
operations.summary: ocrKernelHandler calls subscribeToApproval({ workflow:'ocr', sessionId }, { signal, trackerDir }). Resolves with ApprovedPayload when the operator approves via /api/ocr/approve-batch. Throws OcrDiscardedError on discard, CancelledError on ctx.signal abort.

operations.label: Delegated: stamp approved records onto ctx (approve path)
operations.summary: ctx.updateData({ records, recordCount, fannedOutItemIds, fannedOutCount }) so the kernel's terminal done row carries the approved record set. Actual fan-out (approveTo per-record + approveDocumentTo once-per-PDF) is handled by the /api/ocr/approve-batch HTTP route outside this handler.

operations.label: Delegated: throw OcrDiscardedError on discard
operations.summary: OcrDiscardedError propagates to the kernel → terminal failed row. The discard HTTP route (/api/ocr/discard-prepare) also writes its own failed step=discarded row and cascade-cancels queued child tasks.

steps.label: Force Research: Per-record Re-fan by Name
steps.note: Operator-triggered mini-orchestrator (HTTP route). Clears EID + matchState on selected records then re-fans person-lookup by extracted name. Oath/EC only — verify rows use verify-relookup instead.

operations.label: Load latest OCR row from JSONL
operations.summary: findLatestEntryForPredicate by sessionId+runId (7-day lookback). Throws if not found or formType=verify (guard: force-research is oath/EC only).

operations.label: Clear resolved fields on selected records
operations.summary: For each recordIndex: clears employeeId (flat or nested employee.employeeId), sets matchState=lookup-pending, matchSource=null, matchConfidence=null, verification=null, forceResearch=true.

operations.label: Emit running person-lookup snapshot
operations.summary: emitTrackerRow with status=running step=person-lookup and cleared records so dashboard shows lookup activity.

operations.label: Fan-out person-lookup by name via fanOutAndWatch
operations.summary: fanOutAndWatch dispatches one personLookupWorkflow child per target record using extracted name (spec.carryForwardKey). itemIds: ocr-force-{runId}-r{idx}. 30-min timeout. cascade-cancel on discard-abort.

operations.label: Patch records from lookup outcomes
operations.summary: patchOcrRecordFromEidLookupOutcome(records, idx, outcome, 'name') for each byItemId result. patchOcrRecordUnresolved for missingItemIds.

operations.label: Re-emit awaiting-approval running+done snapshots
operations.summary: emitOcrReviewSnapshot twice: status=running step=awaiting-approval, then status=done step=awaiting-approval. Preserves parentRunId/parentSubject from prior row via readQueueTitle.
operations.note: Running→done pair ensures the dashboard Preview tab refreshes with patched records.

steps.label: Single-page OCR Retry
steps.note: Operator-triggered mini-orchestrator (HTTP route). Re-OCRs one failed or empty page, re-matches, fans out person-lookup for new records that need it, splices results into the existing records array.

operations.label: Load latest OCR row (SQLite then JSONL)
operations.summary: readLatestRow: tries SQLite runs table first via openStateDb, falls back to findLatestEntryForPredicate JSONL (7-day lookback). Throws RetryPageError for discarded/approved rows or missing pdfFileId.

operations.label: Re-OCR single page via vision pool
operations.summary: runSinglePageThroughPool: buildVisionPool → runOcrPerPage on page-{N}.png from pdf-cache/{pdfFileId}/. Returns records or stillFailed=true with updated error/attemptedKeys. On stillFailed, patches failedPages and emits the row without person-lookup.

operations.label: Match new records against roster
operations.summary: Loads roster from rosterPath (row.data.rosterPath), calls spec.matchRecord on each new record. Roster is empty if no path was stored.

operations.label: Fan-out person-lookup for new records needing lookup
operations.summary: fanOutAndWatch per new record where spec.needsLookup returns 'name', 'verify', or 'verify-only'. itemIds: ocr-retry-{runId}-p{pageNum}-r{i}. 60-min default timeout.

operations.label: Patch new records from lookup outcomes
operations.summary: patchOcrRecordFromEidLookupOutcome for each outcome by kind. patchUnresolved for missing outcomes (no result within timeout). Handles name and verify-only kinds.

operations.label: Splice records and update failedPages/pageStatusSummary
operations.summary: Filter out existing records with sourcePage===pageNum (drop old), append new matched+patched records. Remove page from failedPages. Recompute pageStatusSummary (total, succeeded, failed).

operations.label: Emit awaiting-approval running+done snapshots
operations.summary: emitOcrReviewSnapshot twice (running then done) with updated records, failedPages, pageStatusSummary. Inherits parentRunId/parentSubject/__name from prior row.

steps.label: Verify Relookup: Per-record Per-lookup Re-run
steps.note: Operator-triggered mini-orchestrator (HTTP route). Targets a single failed verify-check by re-running either person-lookup or i9-lookup for that record. Only for verify formType rows. Rebuilds checks[] after patching.

operations.label: Load latest OCR row (verify only)
operations.summary: findLatestEntryForPredicate by sessionId+runId (7-day lookback). Throws if formType !== 'verify'. Derives rootTracePrefix from frozen __traceId for trace propagation to children.

operations.label: Emit intermediate running relookup row
operations.summary: emitRelookupRow with status=running step=verify-relookup. Shows queue/session activity while the lookup runs.

operations.label: Branch: person lookup or i9 lookup
operations.summary: input.lookup==='person' → runPersonRelookup (personLookupWorkflow). input.lookup==='i9' → runI9Relookup (i9LookupWorkflow); guards that record.formKind==='oath'.

operations.label: Fan-out person-lookup (person branch)
operations.summary: fanOutAndWatch with personLookupWorkflow: { name, includeCrmDates:true, keepNonHdh:true, taskGroupId:sessionId }. Per-invocation nonce in itemId (ocr-verify-relook-person-{runId}-r{idx}-{nonce}) prevents matching stale completed enrichment children.

operations.label: Fan-out i9-lookup (i9 branch)
operations.summary: fanOutAndWatch with i9LookupWorkflow: { lastName, firstName }. watchWorkflow:'i9-lookup'. Per-invocation nonce in itemId (ocr-verify-relook-i9-{runId}-r{idx}-{nonce}).
operations.note: I9 relookup branch only — oath records with blank officerSigned only.

operations.label: Patch targeted record from lookup outcome
operations.summary: Person: patchOcrRecordFromEidLookupOutcome + applyPersonLookupToVerifyRecord (CRM dates, active status). I9: applyI9ToVerifyRecord (authorized-official signer). patchOcrRecordUnresolved on timeout.

operations.label: Rebuild verify checks for targeted record
operations.summary: buildVerifyChecks(records[idx]) re-evaluates present/found/missing for each check field (name, EID, activeStatus, employmentDate, oathDate, officialSigner) after the patched data.

operations.label: Re-emit running+done person-lookup snapshots
operations.summary: emitRelookupRow twice: status=running step=person-lookup, then status=done step=person-lookup. Re-opens the terminal done row so the ↻ spins until patched records arrive.

notes: OCR is kernel-registered but NOT daemon-mode: it runs in the dashboard's Node process (same as sharepoint-download). No browsers, no Playwright, no selectors — zero Selectors.* references in the workflow.

Step count follows ocrSteps = ['loading-roster','ocr','person-lookup','awaiting-approval']. The legacy 'matching', 'disambiguating', and 'verification' step names are remapped display aliases; they are not in ocrSteps.

DELEGATED vs STANDALONE split: standalone runs (no parentRunId) complete done after person-lookup with a read-only completeness card; delegated runs park at awaiting-approval until operator approves/discards. The Approve button is UI-gated on parentRunId.

Approve fan-out is form-spec driven and handled by the /api/ocr/approve-batch HTTP route (outside the workflow handler): approveTo (per-record → oath-signature signer / EC contact / OnBase import row) and approveDocumentTo (once-per-PDF → oath-upload ticket). Both are optional; a spec may declare either, both, or neither.

force-research, retry-page, verify-relookup are operator-triggered mini-orchestrators (HTTP routes) that reuse the person-lookup / i9-lookup fan-out primitives. They are not part of the main ocrSteps sequence but patch the same OCR row's tracker data in place.

verify form (spec.enrichRecords) suppresses the generic eid-lookup fan-out (needsLookup→null) and delegates ALL enrichment in its hook to person-lookup (CRM dates, active status) and i9-lookup (authorized official).

Root trace-id propagation: the OCR run's traceId is composed from the operation coordinator's rootTracePrefix when delegated (so prep shares the coordinator's prefix). This prefix propagates to every person-lookup child and approve fan-out row.

SQLite task dependencies are the primary person-lookup fan-out wait mechanism; falls back to watchChildRuns on setup error. The anchor task_kind=ocr terminates (done) when its last dependency settles.
